user.title: Connect PeckList
user.description: Make an API key in PeckList under Settings > Account > API keys, with the permissions "tasks:read" and "tasks:write" (or only "tasks:read" for read-only lists).

data_description.url: The address you open PeckList at in a browser.
data_description.api_key: Starts with pl_. It is stored in Home Assistant and sent only to your PeckList server.

reauth_confirm.title: PeckList needs a new API key
reauth_confirm.description: The key for {title} at {url} expired or was revoked. Make a new one in PeckList under Settings > Account > API keys.

data_description.api_key: A key of the same PeckList account.

reconfigure.title: Change the PeckList connection
reconfigure.description: Use this when the server moved to another address, or to swap the key. The account must stay the same.

data_description.url: Where you open PeckList in a browser.
data_description.api_key: A key of the same PeckList account.

error.invalid_url: Enter the address with http:// or https://
error.invalid_auth: The server does not know this key. It may be mistyped, expired or revoked.
error.missing_scope: This key cannot read tasks. Make one with "tasks:read", and "tasks:write" to change tasks.
error.cannot_connect: No PeckList server answered at this address.
error.rate_limited: The server is busy with this account. Try again in a minute.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. The log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This PeckList account is already connected.
abort.wrong_account: That key belongs to a different PeckList account. Add it as its own entry instead.

data.date_field: A date set in Home Assistant goes to
data.completed_days: Days to keep showing closed tasks
data.ha_user: Home Assistant user this account belongs to

data_description.date_field: Used for a task that has no date yet. A task that already has a due date or a scheduled date keeps using that one.
data_description.completed_days: On the to-do lists and in the dashboard card. 0 hides closed tasks after the day they were closed.
data_description.ha_user: The dashboard card can then show each person their own tasks. Everyone signed in to Home Assistant can still see every connected account's tasks.

options.schedule: The scheduled date (as PeckList's quick add does)

auth_failed.message: PeckList no longer accepts the API key. Enter a new one under Settings > Devices & services.

read_only_key.message: The API key may only read tasks. Make one with "tasks:write" to change them.

forbidden.message: PeckList's sharing rules do not allow this change: {detail}

rate_limited.message: PeckList is getting too many requests from this account. Try again in a minute.

cannot_connect.message: The PeckList server could not be reached: {detail}

entry_not_found.message: That PeckList account is not connected, or not loaded.

entry_needed.message: More than one PeckList account is connected. Say which one with config_entry_id.

task_needed.message: Name the task with task_id, or with title.

add_task.name: Add task
add_task.description: Adds a task from a line of text, read the way PeckList's quick add reads it: dates, #tag, ^list, !high, @person and "every week".

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The PeckList account. Needed only when more than one is connected.

list.name: List
list.description: The list to add to when the text names none with ^. A name or an id.

complete_task.name: Complete task
complete_task.description: Closes a task. A repeating task moves on to its next date.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The PeckList account. Needed only when more than one is connected.

delete_task.name: Delete task

get_tasks.name: Get tasks
